subject: SIG evidence phased handback and verification plan
messages:
From: Jacob Myers <jacob@stellarhealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: StellarHealth Security Team <security@stellarhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG evidence request — phased delivery preferred

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for taking SIG on with us. We got the completed questionnaire back from our security operations folks and there are a few evidence buckets we need to validate before we close the control set. Given internal timelines, we cannot consume everything at once — would Redwood be able to do a phased evidence handback?

What we need prioritized (rough order):
- IAM screenshots (RBAC groups, admin console audit)
- Network diagrams + subnet tagging screenshots
- KMS rotation proof + key metadata export
- Runbooks for incident response and escalation (playbook + runbook screenshots)
- Retention policy doc and proof of configuration

Attached: SIG_request_matrix.xlsx (I filled our control references and suggested acceptance criteria).

If you can provide a short delivery cadence (e.g., batch 1 by Aug 4 — IAM + network; batch 2 by Aug 9 — KMS + runbooks), that would help our reviewers plan. We also need a verification step: a 30-min walkthrough where your engineer can share the Drive folder and walkthrough the screenshots.

Privacy note: please redact any customer PII from screenshots.

Thanks,
Jacob
Jacob Myers
Security Lead, StellarHealth

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Jacob Myers <jacob@stellarhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request — phased delivery preferred

Jacob —

Appreciate the matrix and the suggested acceptance criteria — that format helps. We can absolutely do a phased handback. Proposed plan:

Batch A (by 2028-08-04): IAM screenshots (admin console, role mappings), Network diagrams (internal topology + VPC peering map), Drive index.
Batch B (by 2028-08-09): KMS key metadata export, rotation history, and minimal key-policies; incident runbooks and runbook screenshots (IR playbook + on-call escalation flow).
Batch C (by 2028-08-11): Retention policy doc, audit log retention proof, and any remaining artifacts.

Jonas will own the runbooks and screenshots. Vivek will pull the KMS metadata and rotation proof. I will assemble the Drive package and redact any PII before handoff.

I uploaded a working folder and the handoff plan for your reviewers: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB9-phased-handoff-ava (PHASED_HANDOFF_PLAN.pdf is in the root).

For verification, a 30-min walkthrough works for us. Are you available Friday Aug 4 at 10am PT? If not, propose two alternatives. We will provide a short verification checklist and a readout doc so your reviewers can mark items as accepted.

Attachments: PHASED_HANDOFF_PLAN.pdf

Regards,
Ava Chen
Manager, Security & Compliance Delivery
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Jacob Myers <jacob@stellarhealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Aug 2028 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request — phased delivery preferred

On Thu, Aug 2, 2028 at 11:03 AM Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com> wrote:
> I uploaded a working folder and the handoff plan for your reviewers: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB9-phased-handoff-ava (PHASED_HANDOFF_PLAN.pdf is in the root).

Thanks, Ava / Jacob — quick status from my side: I started assembling the runbook artifacts for Batch B. Current items uploaded to the Drive folder (subfolder: runbooks/):
- ir_playbook_v2.pdf (playbook narrative + runbook steps)
- ir_runbook_screenshots.zip (screenshots of runbook tool/state; redacted)
- oncall_escalation_chart.png

Notes: screenshots are redacted to remove customer identifiers; they include timestamps and session IDs we will keep for evidence. I also added a short README in the runbooks folder with step-by-step verification points (what your reviewer should look for). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB9-phased-handoff-ava/runbooks

Vivek — can you confirm KMS export ETA for Batch B (rotation/history)?

Attachments: runbook_network_screenshots.zip

—Jonas
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Jacob Myers <jacob@stellarhealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: StellarHealth Security Team <security@stellarhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Aug 2028 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence request — phased delivery preferred

Ava / Jonas —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the folder links. I reviewed the runbooks README and the initial screenshots — that looks good. Friday Aug 4 at 10am PT works for a verification walkthrough. I'll invite two reviewers from our side (me + one engineer) and share a short acceptance checklist in advance.

Couple of small asks before the call:
- Can you add a one-page index in the Drive folder that maps SIG control IDs to the artifact filenames? That will speed review.
- For KMS rotation proof, we need the key metadata export in CSV format (key id, creation date, last rotation, policy version). If Vivek can provide that to the Drive folder by EOD Aug 8, we're set for Batch B verification.

If those two items are in place, we can mark Batch A accepted during the walkthrough and schedule Batch B verification next week. Also confirm you will remove any user PII — I see the README mentions redaction but want confirmation.

I'll send calendar invite for 2028-08-04 10:00 PT. DocuSign link (for our access agreement) will follow separately.

Best,
Jacob
